title: Dictionary Entries
description: Look at the dictionary entries below. Use the information provided to complete the sentences.

entries.definition: the ability to continue trying to achieve something difficult despite obstacles
bullet_points: Her [determination to succeed against] poverty inspired everyone in the village.
In moments of sudden crisis, officers are trained to [act with determination].
Young athletes frequently [show fierce determination] during tournament finals.
The rescue crew worked throughout the night with [unwavering determination].

questions.text: The young apprentice possessed a relentless __________ all financial hardships and graduate top of his class.
The polar research team crossed the vast ice shelf through sheer __________ in freezing temperatures.

entries.definition: to respect somebody for what they have done or to look at something with pleasure
bullet_points: Voters continued to [admire her for] her honesty throughout the political campaign.
After working alongside the experienced editor, the intern began to [come to admire] his patience.
Modern architects [greatly admire] the structural balance of the ancient cathedral.
Visitors to the national park [can admire from afar] the rare migratory birds.

questions.text: Art historians __________ the subtle brushwork and luminous color balance in this renaissance portrait.
Colleagues throughout the medical faculty __________ her unflagging dedication to pediatric research.

entries.definition: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
bullet_points: Completing the difficult mountain trek gave the scouts a deep [sense of proud achievement].
The scholarship committee evaluates candidates primarily on their high level of [academic achievement].
Preserving the pristine rainforest will remain the minister's most [lasting achievement].
The software developers gathered at dinner to [celebrate an achievement] after launching their platform.

questions.text: The university honors committee awards special medals to students who demonstrate outstanding __________ throughout their four years.
After spending six months carving the wooden violin, the craftsman experienced a genuine __________.

entries.definition: to give an amount of time, attention, or effort to something
bullet_points: Engineers must [devote energy to] making renewable solar batteries more efficient.
Young volunteers often [devote themselves to] clearing litter along polluted shorelines.
Busy working parents should still [devote time to] outdoor activities with their children.
The remaining museum galleries will [be devoted entirely to] regional pottery.

questions.text: Senior researchers encouraged junior doctors to __________ reading peer-reviewed clinical journals each week.
During the humanitarian crisis, dozens of aid workers stepped forward to __________ distributing food and clean water.

entries.definition: not governed or controlled by other people, countries, or organizations
bullet_points: After decades under colonial administration, the nation fought to [become fully independent].
By learning computer programming, teenagers can become [financially independent] at an early age.
The small island territory sought to remain [independent from outside] political alliances.
The philosophy professor was an [independent thinker] who challenged standard assumptions.

questions.text: Because Arthur refused to blindly accept popular dogmas, his mentors praised him as a truly __________.
Through diligent budgeting and personal savings, the young graduate managed to become __________ without relying on family allowances.
